sourceSentences: Last Rites basic attack resets Yorick's basic attack timer.
While there are at least 3 graves nearby and Last Rites is active or on cooldown, Yorick can cast Awakening.
Yorick can use Awakening and Mourning Mist mark to raise 1 Mist Walker from each grave after a 1-second delay, consuming the graves in the process.
Yorick summons a ring of spirits around the target location that arises after a 0.75-second delay, knocking aside enemies hit by the walls over 0.25 seconds, though not through terrain.
Within 210-units, they are pulled inside; otherwise they are pushed away.
The ring remains for 4 seconds as impassible terrain against enemies, granting sight inside the ring.
Dark Procession can only be targeted by enemy champion basic attacks and turrets. The wall takes 1 damage per attack from champions and is destroyed instantly from turret attacks.
Yorick's other pets each have a lower prioritization value, allowing him to delay the turret from targeting the Eulogy of the Isles or a Mist Walker for one attack.
Enemy champions and monsters hit are slowed by 30% for 1.5 seconds and marked as Cursed for 4 seconds.
The target is revealed and inflicted with armor reduction, and continually raises a Mist Walker from each nearby grave, up to a maximum of 4.
Mist Walkers will leap to nearby Cursed enemy champions and large monsters once, attacking them upon arrival.
The Mist Walkers do not leap if they are immobilized or grounded, or if the marked target is untargetable.
Eulogy of the Isles can be recast once while the Maiden is alive after 10 seconds of the activation.
Recast: Yorick sets the Maiden free, allowing her to push the nearest lane until she dies.
When Yorick dies, The Maiden rapidly loses portions of her maximum health over 3 seconds until she dies.
3 Minute LoL : Pour les combos, l'idéal est d'avoir la Vierge active avant d'utiliser W puis E. Attaquer pour utiliser Q avant d'attaquer en sens inverse.
3 Minute LoL : Le A de Yorick est une réinitialisation d'attaque automatique qui permet à sa prochaine attaque d'avoir une portée bonus
3 Minute LoL : Si cette capacité est en recharge et qu'il y a trois tombes à proximité, elle se transforme en une capacité permettant de ressusciter des serviteurs depuis ces tombes.
3 Minute LoL : les champions ennemis doivent l'attaquer pour le briser et se libérer.
3 Minute LoL : Cette capacité peut être réactivée pour envoyer la demoiselle sur la voie afin qu'elle effectue un split push permanent pour lui.
Daveyx3 : The first combo is the auto Q combo. Make sure you always auto attack first before you Q so you can deal more damage. The second combo is E into auto attack Q combo.
Daveyx3 : The third combo is E into W. If you have a very difficult time to land your W properly, make sure you always hit the slow first so they cannot dodge it very easily.
